event_description: Fired when a user successfully completes registration with email or Google OAuth.
Fired when a user successfully logs in via email or Google OAuth.
Fired when a user confirms logout and the session is cleared.
Fired when a user publishes or updates a published idea.
Fired when a user saves an idea as a draft.
Fired when a user discards an idea creation form with fields already filled in.
Fired when a user triggers AI assistance for title, description, or image generation on an idea.
Fired when a user publishes or updates a published problem.
Fired when a user saves a problem as a draft.
Fired when a user joins an idea project as a contributor.
Fired when a user leaves an idea project they were contributing to.
Fired when a user likes an idea or problem (not fired on unlike).
Fired when a user submits a comment or reply on an idea or problem.
Fired when a user types a search query of at least 3 characters in the global search.
Fired on every route navigation via TanStack Router's onResolved event.
